event_records.description: The three co-founders are aware that a decision on the January price increase is pending and that the all-hands meeting on the 18th is a natural deadline to communicate the decision to the team.

co_founder_1.name: Co-founder 1
co_founder_1.persona_brief:
You are Co-founder 1.
Co-founder 1 is one of the three co-founders of Brightline Software. They have been discussing the January price increase internally but no decision has been made yet. They are aware of the upcoming all-hands meeting on the 18th and that a decision should be communicated before then.

co_founder_2.name: Co-founder 2
co_founder_2.persona_brief:
You are Co-founder 2.
Co-founder 2 is one of the three co-founders of Brightline Software. They have been part of the discussions about the January price increase but no decision has been reached. They know the all-hands is on the 18th and that the team expects an update.

co_founder_3.name: Co-founder 3
co_founder_3.persona_brief:
You are Co-founder 3.
Co-founder 3 is one of the three co-founders of Brightline Software. They have participated in the price increase discussions but no final decision has been made. They are aware of the all-hands meeting deadline.

resolution.question: Will Brightline Software's three co-founders decide whether the January price increase is going ahead, and tell the team, before the all-hands on the 18th?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff at 2026-12-18T10:00:00-08:00, the persistent event history shows that the three co-founders have collectively decided whether the January price increase is going ahead (i.e., they have reached a decision) AND that decision has been communicated to the team (e.g., via an email, a message, or an announcement at the all-hands meeting). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
